Giyleas are known as wheel archons, named for their appearance as a flying, armor-plated wheel of fire with eyes on each spoke. They often serve as advisors due to their ability to see through lies, and they have a legendary intolerance and single-mindedness in the pursuit of the punishment of evil. **[Recall Knowledge - Celestial](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 40 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 38 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 [Giylea](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2836) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 29 **Perception** +28; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) **Languages** [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115), [Utopian](/Languages.aspx?ID=36); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +31, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +30, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +29, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +28, [Warfare Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +29 **Str** +6 **Dex** +9 **Con** +6 **Int** +5 **Wis** +6 **Cha** +3 --- **AC** 41 [all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=49) **Fort** +26 **Ref** +31 **Will** +28 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644) **HP** 230 **Immunities** [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598) **Weaknesses** [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) 15 **All-Knowing Eyes** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the giylea's aura, it must attempt a DC 34 Will save. If the creature fails, any [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) check it attempts until the end of its next turn has its result reduced by one degree of success. If a creature is currently disguised or in a shape other than its true form when it fails its save, it also becomes [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) until the end of its next turn.
**Archon's Protection** **Trigger** An enemy damages the archon's ally and both are within 15 feet of the archon; **Effect** The ally gains resistance 20 to all damage against the triggering damage and the archon can make a Strike against the enemy. --- **Speed** fly 50 feet **Melee** slam +30 ([Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)), **Damage** 3d12+14 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire **Ranged** tongue of flame +33 ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 7d6 fire **Divine Innate Spells** DC 37, attack +29 - **7th** [Divine Decree](/Spells.aspx?ID=82), [Divine Immolation](/Spells.aspx?ID=1496), [Scouting Eye](/Spells.aspx?ID=1661), [Zealous Conviction](/Spells.aspx?ID=378) - **8th** [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86), [Ring of Truth](/Spells.aspx?ID=1656) (at will) - **9th** [Detonate Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=1488) - **Constant (8th)** [Ring of Truth](/Spells.aspx?ID=1656), [Truesight](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727), [Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **Fiery Spokes** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=149)) The giylea spins furiously, emitting a rain of divine fire. All creatures in a 60-foot emanation take 12d6 fire damage and 5d6 spirit damage with a DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. The giylea can't use Fiery Spokes for 1d4 rounds. **Focus Gaze** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The giylea fixes their gaze on a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a DC 37 Will save against the giylea's all-knowing eyes. If the creature is under any magical effect that disguises it or has altered its shape, the giylea attempts to [counter](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) that magical disguise effect (counteract +29, 8th rank). After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the giylea's next turn.
